args: For a representative sample of 2025 transactions, does the shopper payment amount, any refund, the resulting merchant payout (gross/fee/net), and the linked ledger entries all tie out consistently?

{"run": "run6", "manager": "cfo", "analyst": "Kofi Mensah", "engineer": "Grace", "situation": "year-end-audit", "week": 2, "night": 1, "request": 1, "grain": "one sampled payment captured in 2025", "columns_requested": ["order_number", "merchant_name", "currency_code", "payment_amount (captured)", "amount_refunded", "net_amount (payment_amount - amount_refunded)", "payout_item_amount (amount of this payment settled into a payout, from payout_items)", "payout_item_fee_amount", "payout_net_amount (payout_item_amount - payout_item_fee_amount)", "ledger_debit_credit_diff (sum of ledger_entries.amount for this payment_id where direction='debit' minus direction='credit'; should be 0)", "ledger_credit_total (sum of ledger_entries.amount for this payment_id where direction='credit', to compare against payment_amount)", "reconciliation_flag ('OK' if net_amount equals payout_net_amount plus payout_item_fee_amount and ledger_debit_credit_diff is 0 and not yet settled payments are labeled 'PENDING PAYOUT', else 'CHECK')"], "details": "Source: payments (status captured/refunded/partially_refunded, captured_at in 2025) as the base. LEFT JOIN payout_items on payment_id (some payments may not be in a payout yet \u2014 show as NULL, not excluded). LEFT JOIN ledger_entries on payment_id, aggregated by direction. Join orders on payments.order_id for order_number, and tenants for merchant_name. Build the sample as: (a) the 8 largest payments by payment_amount (converted to EUR for ranking only, print native currency), spread across different tenants where possible; (b) 8 payments with amount_refunded > 0, choosing a mix of fully refunded (amount_refunded = amount) and partially refunded, across different tenants; (c) 9 additional payments chosen by taking every Nth row ordered by payments.id (deterministic pseudo-random) to represent typical/unremarkable transactions, including at least 2 that have no matching payout_items row yet if any exist. Do not convert money columns to EUR (keep each row in its own currency_code so the diff/reconciliation checks are exact, not rounded by conversion). Order by sample category then by payment_amount descending within category; 25 rows total.", "builds_on": []}
